pins.command: r=$(node tools/size-budget.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*wildcard matching a directory'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 1 ]
pins.evidence: FAIL a wildcard matching a directory sums its files, never its inode

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*(between the bundle and the repo root|root.s own node_modules)'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 2 ]
pins.evidence:
FAIL a node_modules between the bundle and the repo root refuses (drift gate and --freshness --bundle)
  ok the repo root's own node_modules is the install, not a shadow

pins.command: r=$(node tools/checks-vendor.mjs --self-test 2>&1 | grep -E '^  (ok|FAIL) .*hard-linked member'); echo "$r"; [ "$(echo "$r" | grep -c '^  ok')" -eq 1 ]
pins.evidence: FAIL export over a hard-linked member replaces the entry and leaves the linked host file alone
